title: In Memoriam Santa Carita City Council

segments.text: hi this is George Peterson former mayor
of the city of Santa Clarita and I'm
here today to wish the city of Santa
Clarita a happy happy very happy
birthday happy birthday city of Santa
Clarita my memories of this city go back
to 1994 from the earthquake and we were
really in dire needs at that time for
leadership and for help from every
direction this city came together like
no other city I've ever known we
resolved not all our problems if we
slowly got hold of all the problems that
we've been facing and the city came back
bigger stronger and better than ever
people say well why do you live here
what is it that you feel good about it's
what you find when you move here it's
the things that you just don't find in
other places and people say well why you
know why do you want to be why did you
want to be a city well there are a lot
of good reasons and then probably as
many reasons as are people who live here
but basically it's self-determination
and always has been inflicted this for a
lot of years the possibility of our own
County and these kinds of things settled
in and became a city
